sourceRefs.locator: Gaceta Oficial núm. 18451, 1 November 1977. Entry names the two instruments and the agreements implementing them, dates the signature, entry into force and noon termination of the canal treaty.

Selected Documents no. 6C (January 1978), printed pp. 3–5, Washington signing ceremony and English translation of Torrijos’s reservations. Panama Canal Treaty, pp. 41–50, Articles II.2, III.3, XI.1–2 and XIII on the deadline, appointments, jurisdiction and property. Neutrality Treaty, pp. 51–52, Articles I–V. The Letter of Submittal, p. 6, distinguishes the joint declaration of 3 April 1964 from the two presidents’ agreement announced on 24 September 1965 to replace the 1903 convention.

Exhibition script, sections 4.4–4.5 on the ballot and debate under the military government, 5.1 on the end of the zone, 8.2 on training and constitutional change, and 8.3 on the two separate December ceremonies, participants and clock.

Slide 29, “Last Day of US-Run Post Offices”. The pictured cover has the Cristobal cancellation of 30 September 1979, green 25-cent Wallace stamp and rectangular handstamp for the last day of the Canal Zone Postal Service.

Panama Ports Company Cristobal, Descripción del puerto, posición geográfica (WGS). The harbour locates the postal town approximately. The historic postal counter is not identified by these coordinates.
Port authority WGS position for Cristóbal. Orientation for the postal town, not a historic post office building.
